indexes.name: binary_cleanup_pkey

indexes.name: storage_cleanup_pending
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX storage_cleanup_pending ON storage.binary_cleanup USING btree (queued_at) WHERE (completed_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: manifest_entries_manifest_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (manifest_id) REFERENCES storage.manifests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: manifest_entries_size_bytes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes >= 0 AND size_bytes <= '5497558138880'::bigint)

constraints.name: manifest_entries_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (state::text = ANY (ARRAY['expected'::character varying, 'verified'::character varying, 'deleted'::character varying, 'skipped'::character varying, 'conflict'::character varying]::text[]))

indexes.name: manifests_confirmed
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX manifests_confirmed ON storage.manifests USING btree (space_id, version DESC) WHERE ((status)::text = 'confirmed'::text)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tickets_token_hash_key ON storage.tickets USING btree (token_hash)

constraints.name: tickets_expected_size_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (expected_size IS NULL OR expected_size >= 0 AND expected_size <= '5497558138880'::bigint)

constraints.name: transfer_parts_transfer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (transfer_id) REFERENCES storage.transfers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: storage_transfer_reconciliation
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX storage_transfer_reconciliation ON storage.transfers USING btree (status, updated_at)

indexes.name: storage_transfer_reservations
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX storage_transfer_reservations ON storage.transfers USING btree (space_id, expires_at) WHERE (((direction)::text = 'upload'::text) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'uploading'::character varying, 'verifying'::character varying])::text[])))

indexes.name: transfers_final_storage_key_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transfers_final_storage_key_key ON storage.transfers USING btree (final_storage_key)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transfers_ticket_id_key ON storage.transfers USING btree (ticket_id)

constraints.name: transfers_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (mode::text = 'single'::text AND part_size IS NULL AND total_parts IS NULL OR mode::text = 'multipart'::text AND part_size IS NOT NULL AND total_parts IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: transfers_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text <> 'confirmed'::text OR result IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: transfers_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'uploading'::character varying, 'verifying'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'aborted'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: transfers_ticket_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES storage.tickets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
